```{r anaerobic mic plot}
# Calculate mean score for each age level
df= sheet_list[["Anaerobic_MIC"]]
new_colnames <- as.character(1:15)
colnames(df) <- c("Drug",new_colnames)
logFC=df[, 1:15]
logFC[, 2:16] <- log(df[2:16], 2)

# Calculate mean and standard deviation for each group at each time point
stds <- logFC %>%
  group_by(Drug) %>%
  summarize_all(sd)  %>%
  ungroup()

means<- logFC %>%
  group_by(Drug) %>%
  summarize_all(mean)  %>%
  ungroup()

means_long <- melt(means, id.vars = "Drug", variable.name = "Day_No", value.name = "MIC")
stds_long <- melt(stds, id.vars = "Drug", variable.name = "Day_No", value.name = "STD")
data=cbind(means_long, stds_long$STD)
# Create a line plot for each sample

ggplot(data, aes(x = Day_No, y = MIC, color = Drug, group=Drug)) +
  geom_line(aes(color=Drug), size=1) +
  geom_point(size=2)+
  theme_bw()+
  geom_errorbar( aes(ymin = MIC-stds_long$STD, ymax = MIC+stds_long$STD),width = 0.4, size=.7, position=position_dodge(0.2)) +
   theme(
    text = element_text(size = 20),        # Change font size of all text
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16),   # Change font size of axis text
    axis.title = element_text(size = 20),  # Change font size of axis titles
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, hjust=0.5),  # Change font size of plot title
    legend.text = element_text(size = 20), # Change font size of legend text
    legend.title = element_text(size = 20), # Change font size of legend title
  panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank()) +
  labs(x = "Day", y = expression(log[2]('MIC')), title = "Anaerobic Evolution")
```

```{r make boxplot aerobic}
# Replace 'path_to_workbook' with the actual path to your Excel file
path_to_workbook <- "C:/Users/jmf7ak/OneDrive - University of Virginia/24_SPRING/oxygen_evolutions/OXYGEN_EVOLUTION.xlsx"

# Get the sheet names from the workbook
sheet_names <- excel_sheets(path_to_workbook)

# Read all sheets into a list of dataframes
sheet_list <- lapply(sheet_names, function(.sheet) {
  df <- read_excel(path = path_to_workbook, sheet = .sheet)
})

# Optional: Convert list elements to data frames (if you prefer data frames)
sheet_list <- lapply(sheet_list, as.data.frame)

# Assign names to the list elements based on sheet names
names(sheet_list) <- sheet_names

df_aerobic= sheet_list[["Aerobic_MIC"]]
df_anaerobic = sheet_list[["Anaerobic_MIC"]]

df_aerobic = df_aerobic %>% mutate(FC = (log(df_aerobic[15]/df_aerobic[3], 2))) %>% mutate(experiment = 'aerobic')
df_anaerobic = df_anaerobic %>% mutate(FC = (log(df_anaerobic[15]/df_anaerobic[3], 2)))%>% mutate(experiment = 'anaerobic')

aerobic_names <- colnames(df_aerobic)
anaerobic_names <- colnames(df_anaerobic)
common_names <- intersect(aerobic_names, anaerobic_names)

df= rbind(df_aerobic[common_names], df_anaerobic[common_names])

ggplot(df, aes(x = factor(experiment, c('anaerobic','aerobic')), y = FC$d14, fill=Drug)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_grid( .~ Drug) +
  geom_jitter(height = 0) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
       x = "Evolution Conditions",
       y=expression(log[2](ΔMIC)),x="",  xaxt = "n" 
       
  )+
   theme(
    text = element_text(size = 16),        # Change font size of all text
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),   # Change font size of axis text
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16),  # Change font size of axis titles
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16),  # Change font size of plot title
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16), # Change font size of legend text
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16), # Change font size of legend title
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
  

pq=getwd()
ggsave('grantfigg.tiff',path = pq , width = 7, height = 5, device='tiff', dpi=500)
```

```{r anaerobic to aerobic plots}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
# Step 1: Calculate per-Drug max for label.y
label_positions <- df %>%
  group_by(Drug) %>%
  summarise(label_y = max(FC$d14, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.5)

# Step 2: Build base plot
p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = factor(experiment, c('anaerobic', 'aerobic')), y = FC$d14, fill = Drug)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  geom_jitter(height = 0, width = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ Drug, scales = "free") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "",
    y = expression(log[2](ΔMIC))
  ) +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

# Step 3: Loop over Drugs and add per-panel stat_compare_means
for (i in seq_along(label_positions$Drug)) {
  drug <- label_positions$Drug[i]
  label_y <- label_positions$label_y[i]
  
  p <- p + stat_compare_means(
    data = df %>% filter(Drug == drug),
    aes(group = experiment),
    method = "wilcox.test",
    label = "p.signif",
    comparisons = list(c("anaerobic", "aerobic")),
    label.y = label_y
  )
}

p
# Step 4: Save the plot
pq <- getwd()
ggsave('oxygen_evolution.png', plot = p, path = pq, width = 7, height = 5, device = 'png', dpi = 500)
```

```{r Ph evolutions pip}

# Replace 'path_to_workbook' with the actual path to your Excel file
path_to_workbook <- "C:/Users/jmf7ak/OneDrive - University of Virginia/24_SPRING/pH evolutions/pH_evolution_mics.csv"

# Read all sheets into a list of dataframes
  df <- read_csv(path_to_workbook)

  logFC=df
  
logFC[, 2:12] <- log(df[2:12], 2)
logFC = logFC %>% filter (Drug == 'PIP')
# Calculate mean and standard deviation for each group at each time point
stds <- logFC[, 2:14] %>% select(-Drug) %>%
  group_by(pH) %>%
  summarize_all(sd)  %>%
  ungroup()

means<- logFC[, 2:14] %>% select(-Drug) %>%
  group_by(pH) %>%
  summarize_all(mean)  %>% 
  ungroup()

means_long <- melt(means, id.vars = "pH", variable.name = "Day_No", value.name = "MIC")
stds_long <- melt(stds, id.vars = "pH", variable.name = "Day_No", value.name = "STD")
data=cbind(means_long, stds_long$STD)
# Create a line plot for each sample

custom_colors <- c("5.5" = "#A7F3D0", "6.5" = "#059669", "7.5" = "#064E3B")

ggplot(data, aes(x = Day_No, y = MIC, color = factor(pH, c('5.5','6.5','7.5')), group=factor(pH, c('5.5','6.5','7.5')))) +
  geom_line(aes(color=factor(pH, c('5.5','6.5','7.5'))), size=1.5) +
  geom_point(size=3)+
  theme_bw()+
  geom_errorbar( aes(ymin = MIC-stds_long$STD, ymax = MIC+stds_long$STD),width = 0.4, size=.5, position=position_dodge(0.2)) +
   theme(
    text = element_text(size = 20),        # Change font size of all text
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16),   # Change font size of axis text
    axis.title = element_text(size = 20),  # Change font size of axis titles
    plot.title = element_text(size = 20, hjust=0.5),  # Change font size of plot title
    legend.text = element_text(size = 20), # Change font size of legend text
    legend.title = element_text(size = 5), panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    # Change font size of legend title
  ) + scale_color_manual(values = custom_colors)+
  labs(x = "Day", y = expression(log[2]('MIC')), title = "pH Evolution PIP")
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(broom)

# Ensure pH is a factor
df$pH <- as.factor(df$pH)

# Run Kruskal-Wallis test for each Drug group
kw_results <- df %>%
  group_by(Drug) %>%
  summarise(
    kruskal = list(kruskal.test(logfc ~ pH, data = cur_data())),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(tidy_result = lapply(kruskal, tidy)) %>%
  unnest(tidy_result) %>%
  select(-kruskal)

# View results
print(kw_results)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Define pairwise comparisons
my_comparisons <- list(
  c("5.5", "6.5"),
  c("6.5", "7.5"),
  c("5.5", "7.5")
)

# Make sure pH is a factor
df$pH <- factor(df$pH, levels = c('5.5', '6.5', '7.5'))

# Plot with stat_compare_means per facet
p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = pH, y = logfc, fill = pH)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_wrap(. ~ Drug) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Greys", name = "pH") +
  labs(y = expression(log[2](ΔMIC))) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "top"
  ) +
  stat_compare_means(
    comparisons = my_comparisons,
    method = "wilcox.test",
    label = "p.signif",
    size = 5
  )+
  ylim(NA, 8.5) 

p

# Save figure
pq <- getwd()
ggsave('pH_Evolution.png', plot = p, path = pq, width = 6, height = 4, device = 'png', dpi = 500)
```


```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)

# Define pairwise comparisons
my_comparisons <- list(
  c("5.5", "6.5"),
  c("6.5", "7.5"),
  c("5.5", "7.5")
)

# Make sure pH is a factor
df$pH <- factor(df$pH, levels = c('5.5', '6.5', '7.5'))

# Create an interaction factor combining Drug and pH
df <- df %>%
  mutate(fill_var = factor(paste(Drug, pH, sep = "_")))

# Define custom hex codes (Greens for PIP, Reds for CIP, Blues for TOB)
drug_ph_colors <- c(
  # Piperacillin (PIP) - Greens
  "PIP_5.5" = "#C8E6C9", 
  "PIP_6.5" = "#4CAF50", 
  "PIP_7.5" = "#1B5E20", 
  
  # Ciprofloxacin (CIP) - Reds
  "CIP_5.5" = "#FC9272",
  "CIP_6.5" = "#DE2D26",
  "CIP_7.5" = "#67000D",
  
  # Tobramycin (TOB) - Blues
  "TOB_5.5" = "#9ECAE1",
  "TOB_6.5" = "#2171B5",
  "TOB_7.5" = "#08306B"
)

# Plot with custom interaction fill and complete statistical brackets
p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = pH, y = logfc, fill = fill_var)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  facet_wrap(. ~ Drug) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = drug_ph_colors, guide = "none") + 
  labs(y = expression(log[2](ΔMIC)), x = "") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    # Completely remove grid lines
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  ) +
  stat_compare_means(
    comparisons = my_comparisons,
    method = "wilcox.test",
    label = "p.signif",
    size = 4.5,
    bracket.size = 0.5,
    tip.length = 0.02,
    hide.ns = FALSE,     # Forces non-significant (ns) brackets to display
    step.increase = 0.08 # Stacks brackets vertically to avoid overlap
  ) +
  ylim(NA, 9.5)          # Extended y-limit to accommodate all stacked brackets

p

# Save figure
pq <- getwd()
ggsave('pH_Evolution.png', plot = p, path = pq, width = 6, height = 4, device = 'png', dpi = 500)
```

```{r}
      cutpoints = c(0, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 1),
      symbols = c("***", "**", "*", "ns")
    )
  ) +  
  theme_bw() +

    text = element_text(size = 18),

  ) +
  theme(
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    text = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    legend.key.size = unit(1, 'cm'),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  ) + 
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(-4, 6, by = 2))
pq=getwd()
ggsave('media_Evolution.png',path = pq , width = 6, height = 4, device='png', dpi=500)
```

```{r}
library("readxl")
library('ggpubr')
library('ggsignif')
library('dplyr')

# Load data
my_data <- read_excel("C:/Users/jmf7aK/OneDrive - University of Virginia/22_SUMMMER/medialogs.xlsx")

# Rename factor values in the data frame so the labels change cleanly
my_data$media <- recode(my_data$media, 
                        "Urine" = "SHU", 
                        "Chronic Wound" = "SCWE")

# Re-level factors for desired plotting order
my_data$media <- factor(my_data$media, levels = c('SHU', 'LB', 'SCWE'))

# Define comparisons using the new names
my_comparisons <- list(c("LB", "SCWE"), c("LB", "SHU"), c("SCWE", "SHU"))

compare_means(logs ~ media, data = my_data, group.by = "drugs", p.adjust.method = 'BH')

# Box plot faceted by "drugs"
p <- ggboxplot(my_data, x = "media", y = "logs",
               color = "media", palette = "jco",
               add = "jitter", facet.by = "drugs"
) + labs(y = expression(log[2](ΔMIC)), x = "")

# Add significance stats and themes
p + stat_compare_means(
    label = "p.signif",
    comparisons = my_comparisons,
    label.y = c(6.2, 7.0, 7.8),
    vjust = 0.25,
    symnum.args = list(
      cutpoints = c(0, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 1),
      symbols = c("***", "**", "*", "ns")
    )
  ) +  
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(), # Keeps x-axis text clean if facets show categories
    # Remove grid lines entirely
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    # Legend formatting & top positioning
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.key.size = unit(1, 'cm'),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16)
  ) + 
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(-4, 6, by = 2))

pq <- getwd()
ggsave('media_Evolution.png', path = pq, width = 6, height = 5, device = 'png', dpi = 500)
```
